question: Across the 63 original amplicons, what paired increment does FOXP1 add to the measured FOS-free JUN footprint, and what independently sampled native accessibility and methylation differences are measurable at each locus?
decision: Following owner review of Stage 1, construct per-locus inputs. Hold association analysis and external candidates for a separate owner decision.
strongest_rival: A high ratio can arise from a small JUN baseline. Wider, CpG-rich intervals have different measurement opportunity. Tissue composition, control baselines, one library per biochemical condition and few native mice can influence the apparent effects.
discriminator: Retain absolute binding scores, differences and ratios, motif class, whole-amplicon native fragment CPM and source-scale methylation means for each arm; record fixed opportunities and counts. The frozen design defines future association and sensitivity checks.
exposure_record: Paper, S0–S6, sample identity, source addresses, motif classes, CpG and fragment coverage were seen. Stage 1 inspected raw eligibility and dimensions. Per-locus history differences, new binding summaries and cross-locus relationships were not computed or inspected in planning.
biological_unit: Binding pairs are sequences from one assay library per condition. Native ATAC and whole-colon methylation units are individual mice. P4 organoid units are original mouse-derived lines.
nesting_and_overlap: Barcodes and fragments nest in mice; common plus-C sites nest in loci and source specimens. The 63 loci are repeated features within each mouse or library. Native cohorts have no individual match across modalities.
population_and_selection: All 63 released binding amplicons. Select the extended sorted epithelial ATAC export, all qualified mice and fixed 300-autosomal-fragments-per-barcode floor. Use the six P4 lines and six tissue vehicle mice, with no drug-treated or main-series supplementation.
contrast: Raw JUN+FOXP1 minus JUN alone; raw quotient if JUN nonzero and fold subset on a nonnegative scale with positive JUN. At day 50/102 take mean recovered minus mean control mouse CPM. For each methylation model and each window take recovered minus control mouse/line mean fraction times 100. Retain only recovered-mouse descriptions as quantitative day-79 measurements.
endpoint: Per-locus paired raw biochemical scores; fragment counts, denominators and CPM; common-CpG source fractions, specimen averages and differences in percentage points. Separate motif and flanks, interval width and reference CpGs per 100 bp. One gallery-matched DejaVu Sans multipanel figure.
methods: Use exact Table 6 physical rows. ATAC counts are unique fragment overlaps to the whole fixed amplicon divided by all qualified autosomal unique fragments of that mouse times 1e6; retain CPM/kb as a secondary width adjustment. Average mice equally. For each model and window, use the Stage 1 fixed sites measured in all six original specimens; average sites equally within a specimen, then specimens equally within arm. See hash-bound DESIGN.md for the subsequent day-102 partial rank correlation and prespecified validity checks. No association computed here.
missingness_and_exclusions: Zero target fragments with a positive denominator gives zero CPM. Failed day-79 control mapping has missing depth-normalized values; no day-79 group contrast. No common CpG gives missing methylation with usable n=0. Zero JUN denominator gives missing ratio; negative scores cannot supply ordinary fold interpretation.
multiplicity: Measurement checkpoint only. No association coefficients, significance tests or multiple-testing decisions. Retain all 63 intervals and every unfavorable or unavailable estimate.
precision_basis: Two ATAC controls at each comparative time point; two or four recovered mice. Three specimens per arm in each separate methylation model. One library per biochemical condition and one scored motif CpG constrain inference.
interpretation_limit: Source-scale descriptive contrasts from selected amplicons do not establish cellular occupancy, persistent JUN/FOXP1 protein, methylation-driven binding, causal memory or matched-individual effects.
stop_rule: Stop on input hash mismatch, duplicate or inconsistent interval/source keys, disagreement with fixed sample and opportunity counts, or unexpected zero-depth cases. Stop after the per-locus checkpoint for owner review.
amendment_reason: Owner-requested Stage 2 measurement checkpoint after reviewed Stage 1. The prospective subsequent association design is frozen separately from its possible execution.
